deadline.value: Doctoral applications for fall entry should reach admissions by February 15; the catalog says applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

also.quote: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

gre_general.value: PhD applicants must submit GRE verbal, quantitative and analytical scores with their application.
gre_general.quote: Applicants must submit a letter outlining tentative research interests and career goals along with GRE verbal, quantitative, and analytical test scores

gre_subject.value: Computer science has no GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: Each doctoral student gets an academic advisor after admission; the catalog does not say a supervisor must agree before admission.
supervisor.quote: All students pursuing a doctoral degree will have an academic advisor (and co-advisor, if applicable) who must be a member of the Missouri S&T graduate faculty.

funding.value: The catalog says financial assistance is available but gives no funding rate.

entry_route.value: Applicants without a graduate degree normally start in the M.S. program, though outstanding applicants can enter the PhD directly.
entry_route.quote: Applicants who do not have a graduate degree will normally request admission to the M.S. program first but, outstanding applications will be admitted directly into the Ph.D. program

notes: The catalog's M.S. TOEFL figure (570/230/89) is for the M.S. only, so the PhD uses the university TOEFL. Department PhD pages on the mst.edu subdomains could not be reached (TLS verification failure through the proxy); this record uses the graduate catalog only.
